journey.name: usdt independent recovery
journey.description: Requires an onboarded wallet using an owned local test seed and recipient, controlled USDT RPC/bundler, VSS storage and Pubky homeserver fault injection. These fixtures are not supplied by the standard journey environment. Report blocked when they are unavailable. Record operation IDs, signed payloads and bundler submissions. Restart and restore only these disposable test wallets.

actions.action: Make Pubky unavailable while VSS works. Send a small ordinary USDT payment. Verify its recovery backup is acknowledged before the bundler receives the signed operation, and the payment can confirm without Pubky. Verify the existing complete wallet backup remains readable.

Reject the USDT backup. Approve one payment and verify Error explains the backup failure, that the same signed payment will retry and that closing the screen does not cancel it. Verify Pending, Details, Retry and Close are available and the bundler has received no operation.

Press Retry twice while backup remains unavailable, then close and reopen the app. Verify one retained payment with the original operation ID and signed payload, no new quote or approval, and no broadcast. Allow VSS acknowledgement and retry; verify recovery submits only that original signed operation. Repeat with a lost VSS acknowledgement and with automatic recovery without pressing Retry.

Hold the Pubky write lock temporarily during Paykit backup or proof delivery. Verify the pending work remains retained, retries slow down to a bounded interval, and recovery after release reconciles the remote outcome before writing again. Restart while the work is pending; verify no duplicate payment request, proof or payment appears. Verify a genuine Paykit payment still requires its authorization and payment-request checks.

Restore the disposable wallet after each failed backup, lost acknowledgement and Pubky-lock failure. Interrupt restoration after core state and after payment associations, then restart. Verify sending stays blocked until all required USDT records are restored and the original payment can resume without another payment. Include both existing complete wallet backups and the independent USDT records.

With two disposable instances of the same fixture wallet, upload different recovery snapshots and change payment associations during an upload. Restore on both platforms and verify every acknowledged transfer remains recoverable, started-payment guards survive, and stale proofs are checked again before use. If the older-format wallet backup is selected, verify newer USDT records are restored without replacing the selected wallet metadata.
